channel.title: Off Road Xtreme - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Off Road Xtreme (offroadxtreme.com)

item.title: 1972 Chevy K5 Blazer: From Rusty Survivor To Dialed LS3-Swapped Restomod
item.description: This 1972 Chevy K5 Blazer was just another aging, run-of-the-mill SUV. That changed when Adams Customs restored the rig and added a LS3 V8.

item.title: 2025 Ford F-550 Overkill Judgment: Six Doors, 43s, And Zero Chill
item.description: This six-door 2025 Ford F-550 4x4 turbodiesel is more than a pretty face. It has a multifunctional tray bed, smooth-riding suspension, more.

item.title: From The Outback To The Backcountry: The History Of GME And Its Expansion Into The United States
item.description: Explore the history of Australia’s GME Radios and its expansion into the U.S. off-road and overland market.

item.title: This Turbodiesel 1946 Dodge Power Wagon Packs 900 lb-ft Of Torque
item.description: This 1946 Dodge Power Wagon 4x4 has been custom built from the ground up. Features include four doors and a potent Cummins turbodiesel.

item.title: Subaru’s Crosstrek Parties Off-Road, Too, Thanks To This RalliTEK Lift And Bilstein Shock Package
item.description: Subaru makes wildly capable off-road vehicles and this lift and shock package take Crosstrek to the next level.

item.title: Out of the Shadows: Lunar Edition 2026 Ram 2500 Power Wagon and Rebel Are Back
item.description: Ram unveils the 2026 2500 Power Wagon and Rebel Lunar Editions, combining bold space-inspired styling with heavy-duty off-road capability.

item.title: 27North TR-27 Expedition Rig: Big Ram Presence Meets Overland Comfort
item.description: With a starting MSRP of $575,000, the 27North TR-27 overland rig occupies the upper tier of the American expedition truck market.

item.title: Built For The Backcountry: MPA Off-Road’s Latest Trail-Ready Machines
item.description: MPA Off-Road in Michigan showcases a lineup of builds including a Toyota 4Runner, Jeep Gladiators, Toyota Tacoma, and a classic Ford F-350.

item.title: AWDROLA Takes On The Mint 400: From Viral Concept To Desert Contender
item.description: The wild AWDROLA—an all-wheel-drive 1989 Toyota Corolla GT-S tribute build—takes on the legendary 2026 Mint 400 in the Gambler class.

item.title: The 1942 Ford Jeep Is A Mechanical Masterpiece, Maybe Even The Greatest Vehicle Ever Made
item.description: The 1942 Ford Jeep stands as a symbol of wartime engineering. This lightweight off road legend remains a favorite among vintage collectors.
